name: Beach Green Hotel
suitableFor: Couples and small groups wanting a simple coastal base between Brighton and Worthing
beachAccess: Not stated; the hotel describes itself as on the South Coast between Brighton and Worthing
confirmedFeatures: 8 bedrooms, sea views from most rooms, high-speed internet, coffee, breakfast, lunch, dinner and drinks served daily
overview: Beach Green Hotel sits on South Street in Lancing, a short hop west of Shoreham along the coast road. It has eight bedrooms, most looking out to sea, and runs a café-bar that is open every day from breakfast through to evening drinks, so food is sorted without leaving the building.
surfTripFit: A small sea-view hotel a few minutes west of Shoreham, with food served all day for before and after a session.
